conclusion_ceiling: rival-partition power within the declared finite manifest only
guards: target labels used only for evaluation, not intervention/decoder construction

high_cardinality_zero_gain.reason: factor is a relabelling of the base profile and cannot split a base fibre

overlap_requires_deduplication.lesson: overlapping separated pairs must be counted once

profile_derived_restriction.lesson: a factor determined by the current profile cannot refine its fibres

target_leak_full_gain_but_ineligible.reason: candidate is the disputed target coordinate itself

two_weak_factors_jointly_complete.lesson: weak factors can cover complementary residual collision pairs

narrow_statement: candidate-factor gain is the number of current cross-target fibre collisions it separates; residual collisions equal initial collisions minus covered pairs, and set gain is monotone submodular
selection_rule: among eligible target-blind candidates, rank by marginal residual-collision reduction under the frozen manifest and guards; retain negative results that zero out a repair family
